subject: Compliance kickoff: log-window uplift, SOC 2 re-attest & term amendment for renewal
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@pelorus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@pelorus.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal request: SOC 2 re-attest scope + log retention uplift and capacity increase

Hi Markus,

We’re approaching our contract renewal with Redwood (expiring 2028-08-31) and there are three asks from security and procurement that I wanted to surface early so we can align timelines: 

1) SOC 2 re-attestation scope — our security team wants confirmation that the upcoming attestation will cover the dedicated dataset routing and the new prefix-KV cache behavior we use in production.
2) Audit log retention — Pelorus needs audit/log retention extended from 12 months to 24 months for the next 12-month term (regulatory requirement for one of our product lines).
3) Capacity/seat uplift — we will increase committed seat capacity on Dedicated by ~30% and would like that reflected in the renewal terms and pricing.

Can you confirm what evidence you can provide for (1), whether Redwood can support the 24-month retention window for hosted audit exports or a managed archive, and an initial pricing delta for the seat uplift + retention SLA? Also please let me know a realistic timeline for delivering the evidence pack; we’re targeting final sign-off by 2028-08-15 so procurement can route approvals.

I attached a short overview of Pelorus’ asks. Procurement will follow up on contract language. Thanks — looking to kick this off next week.

— Elena Torres
Director, Security & Risk
Pelorus Financial

Attachment: Pelorus-Renewal-Request-Overview.docx (docx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@pelorus.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 re-attest scope + log retention uplift and capacity increase

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Tagging the team to outline next steps.

Summary of what Redwood can commit to and the immediate asks:
- SOC 2 re-attestation: we will ensure the upcoming SOC 2 scope explicitly includes dedicated dataset routing and KV/prefix caching behavior. We will provide a SOC 2 evidence index and the independent auditor’s scope statement for your records.
- Log retention uplift: we can offer a managed log-archive option to extend retention to 24 months. This is an addendum to your existing agreement (small recurring storage fee + access SLA). We will provide an export procedure and an S3-compatible bucket handoff if Pelorus prefers on-prem archive.
- Seat/capacity uplift & term changes: we can model the 30% capacity increase as a seat uplift line item and offer a 12-month term amendment with prorated pricing options; we also have a 24-month committed option with discounted unit rates.

Proposed near-term timeline (can be accelerated with an evidence kickoff call this week):
1) Week 1 (kickoff): confirm final list of evidence artifacts, procurement contact, and retention target.
2) Week 2: Redwood provides draft compliance addendum and SOC 2 evidence index (we’ll include hashed log-samples and evidence pointers, not raw PII).
3) Week 3–4: coordinate any auditor-specific artifacts and finalize pricing amendment for seat uplift.

Action items for Pelorus: please confirm the list of log types you require (auth logs, API request logs, syslogs, KV change logs), and who from security will be the primary contact (Elena suggested Matt Li for procurement).

I attached a short draft addendum that we can use as the starting point. I’ll open a HubSpot deal note (HB-59823) and a DocuSign envelope once the language is agreed.

If that timeline looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff call tomorrow or Wednesday.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0194

Attachment: Proposed-Compliance-Addendum-draft.pdf (pdf)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/59823
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 re-attest scope + log retention uplift and capacity increase

Markus — short note from pricing/finance: we can support the 30% seat uplift as a prorated amendment for the remainder of the current term, with two commercial options:

Option A: 12-month amendment (starts on renewal) — nominal per-seat uplift, storage surcharge for 24-month retention.
Option B: 24-month commit — 12% discount on per-seat rate + storage included in the committed fee (lower TCO).

I’ve attached the seat uplift estimate csv; Laura, can you please own the contract amendment with procurement once we have Pelorus sign-off?

— Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Seat-Uplift-Estimate.csv (csv)
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@pelorus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@pelorus.com>, Matt Li <matt.li@pelorus.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 re-attest scope + log retention uplift and capacity increase

Thanks, Markus and Ben — this looks good and aligns with what procurement needs. Matt (cc) will be the procurement owner and can walk through the amendment language. We accept the kickoff timeline and would like to schedule the call Wednesday 2028-06-14 at 10:30 AM PT (or 2:30 PM ET).

Per your ask: Pelorus needs auth logs, API request logs, and KV-change logs retained for 24 months. We also need the export mechanism documented and a sample S3 export credential/ACL template for our security team to review.

Next steps I’ll take: Matt will send a PoC purchase order (PO to match the seat uplift estimate) and procurement will comment on the addendum. Please send the evidence-index template (SOC2-Evidence-Index-template.xlsx) and the DocuSign envelope when ready.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Security & Risk
Pelorus Financial
